comparison_invariance_and_selection.exact_sign_operator: For c in {0,1,E}, D_c(d)={delta_c(pair):pair in J_AC(d)} and S_c(d)={sign(delta):delta in D_c(d)}. Strict U dominance iff S_c={+1}; strict M dominance iff S_c={-1}; exact tie iff S_c={0}; strict-sign selection dependence iff S_c has more than one sign.
comparison_invariance_and_selection.weak_order_operator: U is weakly superior for coordinate c iff S_c is a subset of {0,+1}; M is weakly superior iff S_c is a subset of {-1,0}.

source binders and source-bound outcomes stay intact
comparison_invariance_and_selection.fixed_U_payoff_cells: At nu=0, the existing low-prior cell, and nu=1, U payoffs are fixed by d; payoff-contrast variation can come only from A_M, although outcome multiplicity may remain.
comparison_invariance_and_selection.high_prior_cell: Every contrast value is necessarily selection-dependent because every u in the nondegenerate interval [u_min,p_1] is attained, even holding b_M fixed; its sign may still be invariant under the exact sign operator.
